scope: Short new-email announcement, consistent list feedback and preserved email paging after connection failures.

topics.title: New email announcement
details: Starting a new email with the keyboard says New email. To field. Automatic draft names and the sending account are omitted. Voice commands retain the guided recipient, subject and message prompts. New email to sender starts in the Subject field.

topics.title: Consistent list boundaries
details: Boundary feedback comes before optional list guidance so high, medium and low verbosity retain it. Entering an inbox announces the first or last boundary, including both for a single message. Entering a settings choice announces its boundary as well as its value. Empty email lists are explicitly identified.

topics.title: Email paging recovery
details: If loading the next or previous email page fails, the current messages, selection and page history remain available for retry. Both message-by-message and page-by-page navigation preserve the existing position.

topics.title: Everyday workflow checks
details: Regression checks exercise keyboard and guided voice email creation, recipient-to-subject-to-body progression, all verbosity levels, inbox entry, singleton lists, paginated messages and connection failures. The release workflow also runs Windows controls and browser integration checks before publishing. Real personal mailboxes and physical microphone interactions still require user testing.
